program_path=program_dir/'task-f0d0b53f.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A single missing horizontal stripe is copied from the opposite edge.
    nonempty = [row for row in grid if any(row)]
    if nonempty and all(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in nonempty):
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r, row in enumerate(out):
            if not any(row):
                out[r] = grid[-1][:]
        return out

    points = [(c-r, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # The diagonal marks encode a short repeating sequence along c-r.
    period = next((p for p in range(1, max(h, w)+1)
                   if all(len({v for d2, v in points if d2 % p == d % p}) <= 1
                          for d, _ in points)), max(h, w))
    colors = {}
    for d, v in points:
        colors[d % period] = v
    return [[colors[(c-r) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
